added_items.item: Warning: writing a heap snapshot pauses the process and needs free memory about heap size; can crash a nearly full heap, so snapshot early not at limit
If rss grows but heapUsed stays flat, leak is outside the heap (Buffers, native addons, streams)
Also watch rss in memoryUsage logging
Use chrome://inspect to connect to --inspect and use 'Objects allocated between Snapshot 1 and 2' sorted by retained size
Inspect retainers list of largest objects to see what keeps them alive

Offer to review code or snapshot summary
